rows.cn: 有关运行环境条件的温度信息
rows.en: Temperature information regarding operating environmental conditions
rows.new_en: Histogram of periodically recorded operating temperatures experienced during battery use.
rows.notes: 描述温度分布记录，不误写成当前瞬时温度；未指定记录或上报间隔。

rows.name:
空闲状态温度下限
Temperature range idle state, lower boundary
rows.engineering:
空闲状态温度范围
Temperature range idle state
rows.cn: 电池在空闲状态下可存储温度范围
rows.en: Battery storage temperature range in idle state
rows.new_en: Temperature range the battery can withstand when not in use under specified reference conditions.
rows.notes: D名称为温度下限、E和格式均为温度范围；按父对象整体范围表述，不仅写下限，也不混为工作温度范围。

rows.name:
超高温时间
Time spent in extreme temperatures above boundary
rows.engineering:
超高温时间
Time spent in extreme temperatures above boundary
rows.cn: 温度高于“温度范围空闲状态上限”中定义的温度范围上限的持续时间累计起来的时间
rows.en: The aggregated time, in which temperatures above the upper boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, upper boundary' are prevalent
rows.new_en: Cumulative time above the upper boundary of the battery's specified idle temperature range.
rows.notes: 工程化高温累计时间拆分项；官方1.0.0未定义同名标量字段，具体阈值及由直方图汇总规则另行确定。

rows.name:
超低温时间
Time spent in extreme temperatures below boundary
rows.engineering:
超低温时间
Time spent in extreme temperatures below boundary
rows.cn: 温度低于“温度范围空闲状态，下限”中定义的温度范围下限的时间总和
rows.en: The aggregated time, in which temperatures below the lower boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, lower boundary' are prevalent
rows.new_en: Cumulative time below the lower boundary of the battery's specified idle temperature range.
rows.notes: 工程化低温累计时间拆分项；官方1.0.0未定义同名标量字段，具体阈值及由直方图汇总规则另行确定。

rows.name:
超高温充电时间
Time spent charging during extreme temperatures above boundary
rows.engineering:
超高温充电时间
Time spent charging during extreme temperatures above boundary
rows.cn: 电池充电期间，温度高于“待机状态温度范围上限”中定义的温度范围上限值的时间总和
rows.en: The aggregated time, in which the battery is charged, while temperatures above the upper boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, upper boundary' are prevalent
rows.new_en: Cumulative charging time above the upper boundary of the specified idle temperature range.
rows.notes: 工程化高温充电时间拆分项；官方直方图没有独立充电状态维度，不能据普通温度直方图直接认定可计算，需充电状态原始记录。

rows.name:

Time spent charging during extreme temperatures below boundary

rows.en: The aggregated time, in which the battery is charged, while temperatures below the lower boundary of the temperature range as defined in 'Temperature range idle state, lower boundary' are prevalent
rows.new_en: Cumulative charging time below the lower boundary of the specified idle temperature range.
rows.notes: 工程化低温充电时间拆分项；官方直方图没有独立充电状态维度，不能据普通温度直方图直接认定可计算，需充电状态原始记录。

Information on accidents

rows.name:
深度放电事件次数
Number of deep discharge events

Number of deep discharge events

rows.new_en: Number of recorded events in which battery voltage falls below its specified operating limit.

Rated capacity (in Ah)

额定容量，动态值
电池实际可用容量
额定容量会随着老化、循环和使用状态发生变化

rows.notes: 不将ratedCapacity描述成实际剩余可用容量；动态属性不等于任意时刻的remainingCapacity，也没有从字段定义得出固定更新频率。
